e.title: The Actuary of the Future 播客
e.summary: 精算未来播客：趋势/技术/职业建议的音频学习资源
e.body:
The Actuary of the Future 播客（Podscan 收录）：精算工作未来专题——趋势、技术与职业建议（音频访谈）。对 RIAA：精算职业的音频学习源——通勤/碎片时间的行业输入（与 [[actuarial-outpost]] 的社区讨论、[[actuarial-ninja]] 的教程互补：播客偏访谈/故事）；听行业人士谈精算 + AI 的未来（衔接 [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] 的职业变化）；英语听力 + 行业知识双收获；求职前的行业语感培养。

e.body_en:
The Actuary of the Future podcast (listed on Podscan): episodes on the future of actuarial work — trends, technology and career advice (audio interviews). For RIAA: an audio learning source of the actuarial career — industry input for commutes/spare time (complementing the community discussion of [[actuarial-outpost]] and the tutorials of [[actuarial-ninja]]: podcasts lean interviews/stories); hear industry people discuss the actuarial + AI future (connecting the career changes of [[hybrid-actuarial-role]]); double gain of English listening + industry knowledge; building industry language before job hunting.
